scripts.title: omni::fleet-status
scripts.description: Read-only host status snapshot for Landscape fleet operations.

scripts.title: omni::version-report
scripts.description: Read-only package/tool version report for Omni governance.

scripts.title: omni::pm2-root-cleanup
scripts.description: Stops only accidental root-owned PM2 daemon with PM2_HOME=/root/.pm2 and moves /root/.pm2 aside.

scripts.title: omni::apt-upgrade-plan
scripts.description: APT simulation only: shows upgrade/autoremove plan without mutating packages.

scripts.title: omni::reboot-required
scripts.description: Reports reboot-required state and related package hints.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-tarball-cleanup
scripts.description: Purges legacy Antigravity manual tarball extractions, build artifacts and downloads across the fleet.

scripts.title: omni::sync-agent-instructions
scripts.description: Synchronizes canonical AI instructions, skills, Landscape directives, cross-harness symlinks and installs recurring auto-sync systemd timer across all fleet nodes.

scripts.title: omni::agy-sessions-list
scripts.description: Lista sessoes Antigravity CLI/IDE recentes de cada host via SQLite e JSONL. Retorna titulo, ID, turnos, workspace e timestamp das ultimas 15 sessoes principais.

scripts.title: omni::xrdp-audit
scripts.description: Auditoria de status do XRDP, sesman, portas X11/VNC e sessões ativas na frota.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-hub-install
scripts.description: Instala ou atualiza o Antigravity Hub (2.0) a partir do tarball oficial na frota, gerando symlink /usr/local/bin/antigravity e atalho .desktop 'Antigravity 2.0' na categoria Development.

scripts.title: omni::xrdp-enforce-single-session-override
scripts.description: Aplica politica de sessao unica no XRDP em toda a frota: encerra sessoes em disconnect (KillDisconnected=true), elimina orfaos Xvnc, previne colisao de portas (5901->5900) e garante sobreposicao de novas conexoes.

scripts.title: omni::antigravity-ui-dimension-fix
scripts.description: Aplica correcao de dimensionamento e corte no topo da janela do Antigravity na frota (titleBarStyle=native no settings.json e decor=yes no Openbox lxde-rc.xml).

scripts.title: omni::fleet-repo-sync
scripts.description: Synchronizes git repositories across ATIUS fleet with declarative policy enforcement.
